review_text: Great place, and interior design of the cafe. Smooth order. Much more chill branch of Starbucks in the city. Inside is spacious and less crowded so you could chill and have your coffee in peace. Would love to come back here to chill, do work, study, and enjoy your drink.

This Starbucks branch is pretty much your regular Starbucks experience — familiar setup, consistent coffee, standard food options, and the usual comfortable place to sit down, meet, or get some work done. Service was good, and one thing I appreciate is the parking space at the back. It is convenient when the adjacent gate is open early, but when it is closed, parking can be a bit more challenging and usually ends up being street parking. The place is along the main street, so the crowd is mixed and the area can look a little congested at times, especially with plenty of Grab drivers outside waiting for pickups. Not really a bad thing, just something you notice when you arrive. No complaints with the coffee and food — it follows the usual Starbucks franchise standards, so nothing too crazy or different, but reliable as expected. One thing I do hope they add soon is support for the international Starbucks app. It would be very convenient for travelers or customers like me who use the US Starbucks app to tap, pay, and earn or use rewards instead of being limited only to the local Philippine app. Overall, a good Starbucks branch with good service, decent parking depending on the gate situation, and the usual consistent Starbucks experience.

Recently went here on a weekday morning around 9 to give this Starbucks a try. I don’t usually frequent big coffee chains and typically prefer smaller independent coffee shops. I was greeted as I entered by the staff even though they were busy with many customers. I decided on the Dark Caramel Coffee Frappuccino. My drink was great and refreshing after a long walk to get there. The CR was clean and they do have free WiFi, but you have to give your personal information. Overall I had a good experience there.

I went to this branch at the perfect time of the day, just after lunch, exactly before the typical merienda or snack time for Filipinos, so the store was not crowded at all, like what most reviewers here have noted. The place is real cozy and has very good ambiance with cement finish, wood accents and well-lighted corners. The store is cleaner, more relaxed, and has better lay-out than stores located at malls. Aside from the seats available inside the store, they also have alfresco area just outside the entrance door. Parking is very generous and free. Located along Torres Street, customers with cars can also park along the sidewalk. Other than the typical Starbucks drinks and food options, they have multiple merchandise available on display. One notable thing that I have observed is that the kitchen and service counters are cleaner and organized compared to other branches.
Love going to this branch! It’s always clean, spacious, and just has a really chill vibe. The staff are super friendly too, they even remember my usual drink, which I love. Definitely my fave branch!

I specifically ordered the tortilla de patatas con chorizo from Starbucks F. Torres because it didn’t contain gluten, a crucial factor for my food allergies. However, I was given the wrong item, an "Oh My Cheesydilla!" that included allergens I’m trying to avoid. I had to go to the ER last week because of an allergic reaction, so I’m very careful about my food choices. This experience has left me frustrated and concerned about the lack of attention to customers with allergy needs. While Grab, the third-party delivery company, refunded the amount I paid for the item, this incident is a serious reminder to take allergies into account more carefully. The situation regarding food allergies, especially in my case, can be life-threatening, and it’s crucial that all parties involved—Starbucks, Grab, and others—take these concerns seriously moving forward.

The atmosphere here is good—comfortable enough to sit for a while without feeling rushed. One feature I really like is the dedicated tables with electric outlets. It’s a small detail, but it makes a big difference for anyone bringing a laptop or tablet. You don’t have to fight for a seat near the wall or worry about your battery running out in the middle of work, which is something I appreciate. Because of that setup, the place works especially well for study sessions or casual meetups. It’s easy to imagine a group gathering here to review notes, work on a project, or even just catch up while having something to eat or drink. The layout encourages a more purposeful stay—you’re not just here to grab food and go, you can actually settle in and be productive. As for the overall vibe, it strikes a nice balance between lively and relaxed. There’s enough energy in the room to keep you from zoning out, but it’s not so noisy that you can’t focus. The environment feels thought out, with practical touches that make it more than just another dining spot. All in all, I’d say this is a reliable place if you’re looking for somewhere to study, work, or simply have an easy meetup with friends.

This location maintains the high standards Starbucks is known for, offering a range of expertly brewed coffees, from rich espressos to smooth lattes. The baristas are consistently friendly and skilled, crafting beverages with precision and a personal touch. The cozy, modern interior is perfect for a casual meetup, a productive work session, or a relaxing break. The availability of comfortable seating and strong Wi-Fi adds to its appeal as a go-to spot for both social and solo visits. In addition to the excellent coffee, Starbucks Torres features a well-stocked selection of pastries and snacks that perfectly complement your drink. The store is clean and well-maintained, and the staff’s attention to detail ensures a pleasant visit every time. Whether you’re a regular or a first-timer, this Starbucks location delivers a consistent and enjoyable experience, embodying the ultimate blend of quality and comfort. It’s a reliable destination for your coffee cravings and a great place to unwind in Davao City.
